title: Clone Doubly Linked List with Random Pointer
problemStatement: A doubly linked list contains the following pointers: prev next random The random pointer may point to any node in the list or be null. Create a deep copy of the entire doubly linked list and return the head of the copied list.
input: A doubly linked list with prev, next, and random pointers.
output: The head of the deep-copied doubly linked list.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 1000]
